answer: Locks are written down in dune, expire in glacier, and shale lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 106 aliases therefore needs 140 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3009 identities would post 4832 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
